newsitem.title: UK: RMC sinks as NatWest cuts 1996 forecasts.
newsitem.headline: RMC sinks as NatWest cuts 1996 forecasts.

text.p: Shares in RMC Plc dropped 6-1/2p to 970 by 1057 GMT on Wednesday after NatWest Securities cut its forecast for 1996 pre-tax profits to 266 million stg from 286 million, dealers said.

Sources said the NatWest downgrade was mainly due to the impact of a stronger pound, adding that a number of other analysts were considering lowering 1996 profit forecast by five to 10 percent because of the recent appreciation in sterling.
"RMC translates (foreign currency earnings) on a year-end basis, so the pain of currency appreciation in 1996 will be felt in 1996," one analyst said.
In September RMC announced a 26.5 percent fall in first-half pre-tax profits to 95.8 million stg and said full year profits would be unlikely to match 1995's record levels.
The building materials company is due to announce its 1996 figures in April.
